title: Unveiling the Secrets of Mocktails and Mockumentaries with David Choe
description: Choe responds to viewers who miss his singing and gratitude, explains being social without alcohol, explores the niche market for nonalcoholic beer and links mocktails to his affection for mockumentaries and documentaries that bend truth toward happiness.
